ios.desc:
- Easy taxi booking 
- Fixed price on all trips
- Pay by card or PayPal directly in the app
- Get status updates for your trip
 
We are Sweden's largest taxi company with cars from Kiruna in the north to Ystad in the south, with strong local presence in order to provide you with the best possible service wherever you are in the country. Our focus is to make your taxi experience as easy as possible, whether it's for private trips or business traveling. 
 
Download the app today to find out how easy it is!
- Start the app and book directly from your current location with Travel Now
- You can schedule future trips by tapping Pre-book 
- Next up is adding your destination to get a fixed price
- Finally tap Book trip to confirm your booking and get a taxi
- You can easily select different payment options (in car, CreditCard or Paypal)
 
We notify you both when the taxi is on its way and when it has arrived. You can also follow your car directly on the map. The app provides you with the taxi's car number so you can smoothly and easily find your car! You find the taxi's car number on the back of the taxi sign.
 
As a registered business customer you also have the option to pay by invoice, travel account or credit card. Your receipts can be sent directly to your company and you save both money and unnecessary time on administration! Contact us today and become a business customer.

Have a burning question? Email us at marknad@sverigetaxi.se
Want more information? Check our website sverigetaxi.se
 
Sverigetaxi is a part of Cabonline group, founded in 1989 and is today a leading European technology and service supplier in the taxi world. Originated in one of the most complex and deregulated markets in the world we have grown organically and through acquisitions. Today, our presence extends beyond Sweden and spans across Norway, Denmark, Finland, Holland and Great Britain.

Sverigetaxi is available in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Blekinge, Helsingborg, Kalmar, Landskrona, Lund, Ale/Kungälv, Borås, Enköping, Halmstad, Karlstad, Kristinehamn, Lilla Edet, Lysekil, Piteå, Sotenäs, Strängnäs, Sundsvall, Tanum, Tranås, Uddevalla, Vänersborg, Västerås, Ystad, Åre, Älsvby, Örebro, Örnsköldsvik, Östersund, Alvesta, Dalarna and Kiruna.

quotes.text:
I mostly have experience of taxi apps from where I live (Stockholm) and basically when one operator had an app, then suddenly all the major companies had apps.
The difference is obviously that there are numerous taxi companies (There used to be one monopoly but at that time there were no smartphones) and the big ones are pretty big, like a 1000+ cars each.

The apps obviously look almost the same and it wouldn't surprise me if they came from the same developer in many cases. Here are four of the largest for comparison:

https://itunes.apple.com/se/app/sverigetaxi/id504540989?mt=8

https://itunes.apple.com/se/app/taxi-sthlm/id375988670?l=en&mt=8

https://itunes.apple.com/se/app/taxi-020/id503115316?l=en&mt=8

https://itunes.apple.com/se/app/taxi-kurir/id503098740?l=en&mt=8

You can see the last 3 just use a skinned standard taxi dispatch app! I appreciate the effort of creating the platform from scratch, but a taxi company shouldn't have to do that. They just license the app.

These taxi companies each had dispatches with many dozens of operators, so they save a good amount of money on using an app and cutting back on people) No difference from other commerce.

The main difference between Stockholm and Chicago is of course that the "taxi companies" are the large city or nationwide companies battling for market share. A taxi driver or group of drivers can also be a "company" but they just operate under the umbrella of the larger brand - who handles all dispatch, branding etc …
quotes.story_title: Chicago taxi industry sliding towards collapse
